technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals present, but severe downtrend structure with price below all major moving averages and negative momentum indicators create high risk for continued decline.

fundamental.summary: CNP shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 21 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (805+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis level 348, rising DXY, CPI event in 2 days) creates severe headwinds for utilities; earnings in 21 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (14) with StochRSI bullish cross and Supertrend reversal signal present contrarian buy opportunity in fear-driven market (VIX crisis, 19/100 fear index).
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe structural downtrend with price below all major moving averages, negative MACD histogram, three black crows pattern, zero fundamental support, no insider conviction, and macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 348, CPI event in 2 days) create unacceptable risk for utilities sector.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and StochRSI cross present technical reversal setup, but severe structural downtrend with price below all major moving averages and zero fundamental support create unacceptable risk-reward in current macro environment.
decision.primary_risk: Macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 348, CPI event in 2 days) combined with earnings in 21 days and negative momentum structure suggest continued downside risk outweighs contrarian oversold bounce potential.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents see oversold reversal opportunity, but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents strongly reject entry due to macro stress and zero institutional conviction.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 10 Utilities positions and existing CNP position; sector concentration and earnings proximity (21 days) warrant reduced sizing; skip entry to avoid over-concentration in defensive sector during macro crisis.
